subject: arcadeCabinet

Category: Object.
Subject: 1980s arcade cabinet.
Style: synthwave.

spec.name: Neon Horizon Arcade Cabinet
spec.description: A 1980s upright arcade cabinet in full synthwave dress: deep purple cabinet, a glowing sunset marquee, a CRT showing a neon grid horizon, chrome controls and magenta-cyan neon trim with an underglow on the floor.
spec.layout: An upright arcade cabinet facing +Z, 0.9 m wide, 1.8 m tall, about 1.0 m deep. From the front: a kick base from y 0 to 0.18 with a recessed lower front panel to y 0.72 carrying the coin door; the control deck protrudes forward to z 0.55 between y 0.72 and 0.95, its top an angled synthwave-sunset artwork panel with a central joystick and two banks of six glowing buttons; above and behind it the screen bay (y 0.95 to 1.5) is a black bezel frame holding a tilted CRT whose glowing face shows a magenta sun over a cyan grid horizon; the marquee crown (y 1.5 to 1.8) leans slightly back and is a backlit sign with a glowing title and sunset stripes, with a perforated speaker grille strip where it meets the screen bay. Two full-height side panels run from floor to crown, deep purple with vinyl side art; the back panel closes the rear. Every visible edge wears bright T-molding trim, and neon edge strips run up both outer front corners with a glowing underglow strip beneath the kick base. Synthwave shows on every part: flat deep-purple surfaces with magenta and cyan hard-edged trim, a gradient sunset only as distinct flat-coloured stripes, and glow on marquee, screen, buttons and neon strips.

parts.builds: The lower cabinet: a kick base from y 0 to 0.18 in cabDark with a slim chrome toe rail, then the lower body from y 0.18 to 0.72 in cabPurple — two full side panels (x ±0.43, from z -0.5 to z 0.45), the back panel, and the front wall recessed to z 0.42 framing an opening for the coin door. Bright trimPurple T-molding strips along the front vertical edges of both side panels and along the kick base top edge; thin trimMagenta pinstripe lines running horizontally along the side panels at y 0.3 and y 0.6; small chrome cabinet feet. Sits flat on the floor.
parts.attaches: Rests on the floor (floor true). Its top face at y 0.72 is the kickTop mount where controlDeck and screenBay land; its front wall at z 0.42-0.45 carries the doorMount for coinDoor; neonEdge wraps its bottom edge at baseUnder.

parts.builds: The coin door assembly hung on the lower front: a brushed-steel door plate (steel) about 0.48 wide by 0.44 tall, seated just proud of the front wall with an ink outline lip. Two round coin slots side by side, each a bezelBlack socket with a chrome ring, a cream illustrated insert and a small glowing neonCyan coin-return LED dot beneath; a coin return cup bottom-centre in chrome with a trimMagenta rim; a small chrome lock cylinder top-right with an ink keyway; four chrome corner screws. Enough detail to be the cabinet's jewellery, kept compact.
parts.attaches: Mounts on the lower front wall of shellBase at doorMount (its top edge y 0.66 meets shellBase's front face); everything rides the coinDoor hinge joint so the door can swing.

parts.builds: The control panel: an angled deck from y 0.72 at its rear to y 0.95 at its front lip, protruding to z 0.55, surface in screenDeep with the artwork built as flat-coloured parts — a sunRed-to-sunYellow striped sun disc low on the panel, thin trimMagenta and neonCyan horizon lines, all hard-edged. Centre: a chrome joystick shaft on the joystick joint topped by a btnRed ball with a cream highlight dot; two chrome shafts with ink collars. Sides: two banks of six round buttons per player side (outer rows btnCyan, inner btnRed, two btnYellow and one btnWhite accent), each button a dome with a dark ink bezel ring seated flush in the panel. Along the front edge a trimPurple T-molding lip, plus 1P and 2P start buttons (btnWhite, btnRed) in a small chrome plate behind the deck's rear edge.
parts.attaches: Sits on shellBase's top at kickTop, its rear edge meeting deckRear where screenBay begins; joystick geometry rides the joystick joint, the panel itself rides cab.

parts.builds: The monitor bay from y 0.95 to 1.5: the two side panels continue (cabPurple, floor-to-crown side art is painted across both shellBase and this part's side panels: a chunky sunset glyph — sunRed disc with neonCyan grid bands and trimMagenta horizontal cuts — as flat-coloured parts on each outer side face). Inside, a bezelBlack bezel frame surrounding a tilted CRT: a dark glass face (screenDeep) recessed, on which the synthwave picture is built as flat-coloured parts — a glowing neonPink sun disc with thin sunOrange and sunYellow horizontal cut bars, a glowing neonCyan wireframe grid floor of thin strip parts receding toward the horizon, small trimMagenta mountain silhouettes, faint cream scanline strips, and a diagonal glass reflection streak in chrome at low opacity. A chrome power LED and a small ink brand plate in the lower bezel corner.
parts.attaches: Sits on shellBase at kickTop behind the controlDeck (which fills to deckRear); its top face at y 1.5 is screenTop where marqueeCrown lands.

parts.builds: The marquee and crown, y 1.5 to 1.8, leaning back a few degrees: a glowing backlit sign panel in a bezelBlack frame — the title built as chunky flat-coloured letter parts in neonPink and neonCyan with ink outlines reading as a retro logotype, over sunOrange/sunYellow/sunRed horizontal sunset stripes and a sunViolet night top; the whole panel glows. Beneath it, where it meets the screen bay, a speaker grille strip in bezelBlack with a neat grid of small ink perforation holes and a chrome trim rail; the top cap of the cabinet in cabPurple with trimPurple T-molding along its front edge and small chrome corner caps.
parts.attaches: Sits on screenBay's top face at screenTop; its glow is the cabinet's crown, visible from the front.

parts.builds: The neon dressing: two glowing vertical neon tubes (neonCyan on the left, trimMagenta on the right) running the full front corners of the cabinet from the kick base to the crown, each a slim round tube with small chrome clips every so often; a glowing underglow strip around the kick base bottom edge in neonPink that throws light onto the floor; a short neonCyan accent arc framing the screen bay's outer corners; a small glowing trimMagenta power bulb on the right side panel near the deck. All glow parts kept slim and bright so the flat purple body stays the hero.
parts.attaches: Wraps shellBase at baseUnder (underglow beneath the kick base, the strip's lowest points just kissing y 0) and runs up the shared outer edges of shellBase, screenBay and marqueeCrown.

1. cabinetBody — the main wooden cabinet shell: sloped marquee top, control panel deck, screen bezel area, sides. Includes marquee (backlit sign) — maybe separate.
2. screen — CRT screen with glow, bezel, screen graphics, reflection scanlines.
3. controlPanel — deck with joystick and buttons.
4. coinDoor — front lower coin door, coin slots, coin return.
5. basePedestal — bottom base/kick plate + maybe a rug with neon grid.
6. marqueeTop — backlit marquee sign with glowing title.
